text:
Based on the provided abstract, the study does not propose or test a "statistically weighted ensemble selection framework" using "Bayesian hierarchical modeling." Instead, the authors use a multivariable integrated evaluation method to rank models across CORDEX domains, define the similarity of pairwise multivariate error fields to measure interdependency, and apply hierarchical clustering to the top 15 performing models to identify relatively independent models.

VERDICT: REJECT
